info.title: SDKWork Order App API
info.description: App/client contract for sdkwork-order capability (split from retired sdkwork-commerce monolith).
info.x-sdkwork-audience: App, desktop, mobile, H5, and user-facing clients.

post.summary: Redeem a coupon into Token Bank credit or a quota-limited subscription.

409.description: Coupon unavailable, changed, or cannot be fulfilled.

post.summary: Create or reuse a membership purchase-intent order.

post.description: Buyer confirms physical receipt: paid/fulfilled/shipped orders advance to completed (fulfillment delivered) with a lifecycle event. Idempotent.

AuthToken.description: SDKWork auth token carried as Authorization: Bearer <auth_token>.

shippingAddress.description: 实物商品必填；数字商品（如兑换码、虚拟权益）可省略。

partnerId.description: Partner bound to the order's customer at creation time.

CommerceOperationCommand.description: Operation-specific command payload defined by the owning commerce Rust module.

status.description: Target status for the after-sales request lifecycle transition.

paymentProduct.description: QR payment product. H5 returns the order-bound cashierUrl; native products create a provider payment intent.

action.description: Membership lifecycle action. Recharge adds quota to the current active subscription's entitlement account; it participates in business purchase-intent identity.

packageId.description: Catalog package external id (purchase/renew/upgrade). Recharge uses the synthetic 'membership-quota-recharge' package id and ignores the catalog.

paymentProduct.description: QR payment product. H5 returns the order-bound cashierUrl; native products create a provider payment intent.

grantQuantity.description: Quota units to add to the membership entitlement account (required for action=recharge).

amount.description: Recharge price in currency amount (required for action=recharge).

reused.description: True when an idempotency replay or an existing active purchase intent was returned.

grantQuantity.description: Quota units granted by a membership quota recharge order (present when action=recharge).

data.description: Operation-specific payload typed per response schema.

item.description: Typed domain resource for the operation.

SdkWorkPlatformErrorCode.description: Platform or domain error code per API_SPEC.md §15.3.

WriteCommandIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
WriteCommandIdempotencyKey.description: Client retry key scoped by tenant, principal, method, and path.
